svg.title: SDLC tracks by phase
svg.desc: The orchestrator's three tracks side by side, by phase (Define, Build, Review, Ship with Learn), sdlc 2.0. Every track writes the same record: intent.md, spec.md (each acceptance criterion with its test) and plan.md in Define, review.md in Review. Define asks only when what, why or how is unclear, one question at a time; a bug is proven first (a failing test or exact steps) and its root cause found. S, a fix: the three files a few lines each, no stop; Build in the session, each criterion's test red first, then verify.py; Review runs the reviews the agent recommends, or none, and says so. M, a feature: the three files in full, which you read and approve; Build in the session; Review stops with a recommendation and you pick. L, a project: the same as M, with the interview run by brainstorming, and the build may run in parts in fresh sessions or as parallel subagents. The recommended reviews: security, code at low, default or high depth, UI (always when the diff touches UI files), the advisor where there is one, or none; each runs once, fresh, on opus, and its high findings go back to Build, fixed test first. Ship, on every track: Learn files lessons and recurring defects before the final commit, verify.py green on that code, push, open the PR, watch CI with one fix, then stop at the PR; merge waits for the user. hookify, security-guidance, model-router, role-guard and trust-anchor run on every track; verify-freshness and prove-budget only in Review. Parts land together: one Review and one Ship after the last part. Deploy is the on-request /sdlc:deploy, not a phase.

g.text: /sdlc:start → the orchestrator picks the smallest track that fits
Sized by footprint, not by risk words: risk raises the review, not the number of steps
hookify: blocks rm -rf, force-push to main, secret values; warns on .only, console.log, comment noise
security-guidance: edit warnings, commit review only when security-touched · model-router + role-guard + trust-anchor
a few files to a few days,
lines in the state file, Intent:
backlog.md when it won't fit one
Each AC's test red first, then
Each AC's test red first, then
verify.py red per AC, once at
The red record and the passing
then reviews the diff in one
FAIL → fix in Build, test first,
Round 3 fails, or one AC fails
Learn: a lesson only, when there
A commit on a feature branch, reported. Merge or PR waits for your word; CI green before any merge.
Backlog (M or L, bigger than one session): each slice runs Build → one commit, no Prove; feature close runs Prove on the whole branch, then Ship.
Any code change after Build's gate goes back to Build: rerun verify.py; with Prove, through Prove again. Autopilot and other agents run M and L in one session.
/sdlc:deploy is on request, not a phase: the project's own deploy path, your go-ahead before production or a DB migration, smoke test, release.md.
